_meta.title: Vehicle-rigging lexicon for bone_forge (Mercenaries 2: World in Flames)
_meta.scope: 168 vehicle models: truck 39, car 36, boat 25, tank 13, helicopter 12, plane 10, motorcycle 8, apc 7, semi 5, towed 4, trailer 3, airstrike 2, vtol 1, bus 1
_meta.hash: pandemic_hash_m2 (FNV-1a, |0x20 case-fold, ^0x2A finalisation). CASE-INSENSITIVE - casing is not evidence.
_meta.expected_false: S*T/2^32. Shrink T, not S: fire at a named structural family, never at all-unknowns.

grammar_rules: prefix is ONLY bone_ (animated node) or hp_ (hardpoint). joint_/jnt_/dummy_/grp_/node_ all return zero.
DOF is named: bone_yaw_X / bone_pitch_X / bone_roll_X AND the reversed bone_X_yaw / _pitch / _roll. BOTH orderings ship; they are different nodes, not spelling variants.
side tokens: l/r (separate or glued). DOUBLED ll/rr means OUTBOARD (bone_propeller_ll = C-130 outer engine at x=+9.76).
position grid: fl fr rl rr bl br ml mr; ALSO side-first lf lg lr rf rg; ALSO fml fmr fc ft mm mt; ALSO fa fb ra rb (fore/aft turret x barrel a/b).
series: _a.._h, glued la/lb/ra/rb, _0.._5, _01.._07. Model-frequency DECREASES monotonically along a series, so the series is visible in census counts before you know a single letter.
destroyed-state variants: BOTH bone_<part>_ruin AND bone_ruin_<part> ship.
LIGHTS CARRY NO SIDE TOKEN - they are a flat hp_fx_light<N> series (1..23, already named). Do NOT generate headlight_l / taillight_r.
negative_results: tank turret furniture (mantlet, cupola, coax, torsion bar, return roller, bogie, smoke launcher, periscope, glacis, stowage, fender): 53,100 candidates, exp-false 0.004, ZERO hits. Those concepts are ABSENT from the dialect - the studio rigged tanks with a generic wheel ladder, not real running-gear anatomy. Do not add them.
headlight/taillight/brakelight/lamp/blinker with any side token: 639,932 candidates, exp-false 0.38, ZERO hits. See grammar rule 8.
damage/LOD/state vocabulary for the 3 universal group nodes: 1,659,348 + 826,143 candidates, ZERO hits.

all 648k witnessed WAD string tokens x 240 affixes vs the 5 universal hashes: 155.5M candidates, exp-false 0.18, ZERO hits. Bone names are NOT in any shipped string table - every name must be cracked.

open_targets.role: ruin-group debris series (12 members, ordered by descending model count)
open_targets.note: PROVEN by suffix-unwinding (2^-32) to be STEM + <single index char>, all sharing one FNV stem-state. Stem unknown: a 161,853-candidate destruction lexicon (exp-false 0.003) returned zero, so the stem is NOT piece/part/chunk/debris/frag/gib/break/ruin/wreck/scrap/junk/shard/hunk, and it is longer than bone_ + 6 chars. Next move: exhaustive wild search on the STEM-STATE (single 32-bit target) at lengths 7-9, on GPU.

open_targets.role: 3 near-universal front/rear mirror pairs, 89-106 models each
open_targets.note: the R-node of the front pair and of rear-B sits at x=0 on all 8 motorcycles - the single-lamp signature - so these READ as lights. But hp_fx_light<N> carries no side token and a 639,932-candidate light grammar (exp-false 0.38) returned zero. Leading alternative: bumper/fender destruction anchors (they are tagged destruction-piece). UNRESOLVED - do not guess a name.

technique_notes: STEM-SHARE (zero-cost witness): FNV-1a is invertible, so unwind(h,suf) recovers the FNV state after the stem. unwind(h1,s1)==unwind(h2,s2) <=> the two names share a stem - a 2^-32 proof of siblinghood costing ZERO candidates. Anchor on an already-named sibling and the unnamed members get named for free. This produced 131 of the 175 names at exp-false 0.22.

TRAP - the mirror-pair constraint is NOT independent. h(X_l) and h(X_r) are BOTH determined by the FNV state after X, so once one lands the other follows automatically: no extra entropy. Also a..g (0x61..0x67) and 1..7 (0x31..0x37) differ by a constant XOR of 0x50, so a genuine _a.._g series silently manifests as a phantom _1.._7 series and as _01.._07. An exhaustive 2.28e9-stem pair-brute returned bone_rjfmj_bl / bone_z7p3w_fl / hp_cwos5_l - garbage at exactly the SINGLE-target rate, not the illusory 2^-64 rate.

The one deliberately high-noise run (unnamed-unnamed stem families, S=2.08M x T=24,100, exp-false 11.7) produced ~12 nonsense names - exactly the predicted count. Readability + side law + domain sense removed every one. The three real finds that survived (bone_sideskirt_*, bone_mudflap_l/r, bone_jet_l/r_yaw) each did so because they were ALSO mirror pairs with correct side law.
